title: Secret Hitler
components: 1 Fascist policy track board (varies by player count)
10 Ja! voting cards & 10 Nein! voting cards
setup: Place the Liberal and matching Fascist boards in the center of the table; set Election Tracker on 0.
Shuffle the 17 Policy tiles face-down into a draw deck.
Distribute secret role envelopes (each containing 1 Secret Role card, 1 Party Membership card, and Ja/Nein voting cards).

Conduct the Night Phase: Everyone closes eyes. Fascists open eyes and identify each other and Hitler (in 5-6 player games, Hitler opens eyes; in 7-10 player games, Hitler keeps eyes closed with thumb raised).
Assign the President placard to a random starting player.
procedure: Each game round consists of 3 sequential steps:
• President nominates a Chancellor candidate (cannot be the previous President or Chancellor in 6+ player games).

• All players simultaneously vote with Ja! or Nein! cards. If majority votes Nein (or tie), the government fails, advance the Election tracker by 1 (at 3 failed votes, top policy is enacted automatically), and pass the Presidency.
• If election passes, reset Election tracker to 0.
• President draws top 3 Policy tiles, secretly discards 1, and passes 2 to Chancellor.
• Chancellor secretly discards 1 and enacts the remaining Policy onto the matching board (no speaking or signaling during drafting).
Step 3 - Executive Action (If Fascist Policy Enacted):
• If the enacted Fascist policy covers an action space, the President must immediately execute the power: Policy Peek, Special Election, Investigate Loyalty, or Execution.
endGame: Liberal Victory 1: Five Liberal policies are enacted onto the Liberal board.
Liberal Victory 2: Hitler is successfully executed via an Executive Action.
Fascist Victory 1: Six Fascist policies are enacted onto the Fascist board.
Fascist Victory 2: Hitler is elected Chancellor at any point after the 3rd Fascist policy has been enacted.
⚖️ Tie-Breaker: No ties are possible in Secret Hitler.
notes: Investigation Power: Investigating a player only reveals their Party Membership card (Liberal or Fascist), NEVER whether they are Hitler.
Veto Power: Once 5 Fascist policies are enacted, the Chancellor may ask the President to veto both drafted policies; if the President agrees, both are discarded without enacting.
Dead Men Tell No Tales: Executed players must leave the table in complete silence—they cannot speak, vote, or run for office.
